## project/.cursor/hooks.json
{
  "version": 1,
  "hooks": {
    "sessionStart": [
      {
        "command": "node ./.cursor/hooks/aidd-telemetry/task.cjs remind",
        "timeout": 5
      },
      {
        "command": "node ./.cursor/hooks/aidd-telemetry/ledger.cjs ingest",
        "timeout": 5
      }
    ]
  }
}
